presidential_approval._note: Computed live from potus-approval.csv by environment.py — this block is a fallback only and is overridden at runtime.
presidential_approval.source: potus-approval.csv weighted average (917 polls, half-life 21d, through 8/3/26)

economy.gdp_source: BEA Q2 2026 advance estimate (released 7/30/26): +1.5% annualized, down from Q1 2026's +2.1% third estimate (advance 2.0%, second 2.6%, third 2.1%). Q2 second estimate due late August 2026.
economy.consumer_sentiment_source: University of Michigan, July 2026 final (released 7/31/26): 55.2, revised up from the 54.4 preliminary and +11.5% from June's 49.5 — a five-month high driven by easing gasoline prices, though still ~11% below a year earlier. Current conditions 54.8, expectations 55.4. Year-ahead inflation expectations 4.2% (down from 4.6% in June).
economy.unemployment_source: BLS, June 2026 (released 7/2/26). Nonfarm payrolls 159.0M (+100k MoM); U-3: 4.2% (-0.1 pp MoM, down from 4.4% peak in Feb '26); U-6 underemployment: 7.9%; participation rate: 61.5%; jobless claims (Jul '26): 187k (-22k MoM).
